entities.name: Al-Alam Kendari Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Al-Alam Mosque is a mosque in the city of Kendari, Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia. The mosque is a destination for religious tourism. The notable features of the mosque include its location in the middle of Kendari bay, and its unique minarets that are shaped like the Burj Al Arab in Dubai.
